speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The patient describes classic fatigable weakness (worse at day's end) and mild diplopia. While a urinary tract infection was suggested previously, the neurological presentation of diplopia and progressive weakness makes this highly unlikely.
